messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw a reproducible glitch in the Node SDK sample during onboarding. Quick reconnects after a client abort sometimes produce duplicated final tokens or shuffled fragments.

alex: Can you paste a minimal repro and config?

maria: Repro steps: 1) start the sample streaming endpoint, 2) send a request, 3) kill the socket (ctrl-c) and reconnect within ~150-300ms. Node SDK v0.9.1; often see either a duplicate final token or a partial fragment appearing before the resume token.

ryan: That smells like our client buffer flush + auth refresh retry racing. We have a 50ms debounce on outgoing buffers — if a resume arrives while the debounce is running we might end up replaying the buffered chunk.

sam: Is the issue observable in Python/sampleapp too? We use a line-oriented parser there.
maria: Less frequent in py, but not impossible. The key differences are framing and how resume tokens are integrated.

maria: Quick curl repro:
```
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"test fast reconnect"}'
```

alex: @ci-bot attach the flaky e2e logs?

ci-bot: build 4678: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/4678 (streaming-e2e flaky)

ryan: Two root causes I saw in logs: 1) truncated delimiter when client abort interrupts a chunk; 2) buffered fragments retried from auth-refresh/retry path after reconnect, re-emitting resume token + buffered content.

maria: Temporary mitigation: increase client keepalive to 30s and add 250ms reconnect jitter in sample app. Not great for first-time devs who expect immediate reconnects.

alex: Proposed fixes: - Server include per-chunk monotonic seq IDs in resume metadata so clients can dedupe. - SDK: emit explicit "resumed" event with last-seen-seq so app-side dedupe is easier. - Make buffer flush on abort deterministic (no debounce during teardown).

sam: I'll add a sample-app toggle to simulate quick reconnects and a small dedupe snippet and tests. Also add a parity test between node/python for abort+auth refresh.

maria: Filing an issue so onboarding docs mention the workaround and link to sample toggles: https://redwood.internal/issue/RED-3124

alex: Sounds good — prioritize a tiny server tag + SDK event change and an integration test. :thumbsup:
